description: Presidential Secretariat - Notifying that Hon. Janaka Bandara Tennakoon, Minister of Provincial Councils & Regional Development has resigned his office w.e.f. 24.07.2015. Notifying that Hon. Eric Weerawardhana, Deputy Minister of Ports & Shipping has resigned his office w.e.f. 24.07.2015.
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively announces the resignations of two named individuals (Hon. Janaka Bandara Tennakoon and Hon. Eric Weerawardhana) from their government positions (Minister of Provincial Councils and Regional Development and Deputy Minister of Ports and Shipping respectively). It contains no details about their portfolio responsibilities, functions, or duties, meeting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette) which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio descriptions.
